QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Equipment Star Power
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Professor Moon, who has something to say about the fallen stars all over Maple World.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: According to Professor Moon, monsters in starstruck areas will neutralize attack damage utilizing the special powers from the fallen stars. Luckily, Star Force enhancements can stop this. Get the required number of Star Force and eliminate the monsters. \r\n
